main_body: dead bare tree with branches and trunk
evidence: The dead tree is drawn as a flat 2D silhouette/front elevation. The top of the tree (row 0) is abruptly clipped horizontally by the canvas edge, and the base (rows 60-62) is a flat horizontal line with no 3D root spread or top-down volume.

style.evidence: Compared to the Beodeul reference trees, which have rich, organic root bases and 3D volume, the candidate is clipped straight across the top edge (row 0) and sits on a flat 2D base bar (rows 60-62). It has a dark near-black outline around the branches and trunk and much lower visual density and structural sophistication than the reference.
